sources.title: Pets in Australia: A national survey of pets and people 2025
sources.period: Survey fieldwork February–March 2025; national estimates refer to 2025
sources.notes: National estimates are weighted and extrapolated using ABS households/population. The 2025 report also publishes comparable historical dog/cat ownership shares for 2019 and 2022 (rounded to whole percentages); no complete state-by-state ownership or expenditure table is published in this edition.

sources.title: Australian Pet Health Monitor 2026
sources.notes: Claims are from PetSure insured pets, not all Australian pets.

sources.title: Australian Pet Health Monitor 2025 – Pets & Road Safety
sources.period: Road-incident claims in 2024; report published in 2025
sources.notes: The state labels sum to 1,303 claims while report prose says 1,304. The publisher includes both motor-vehicle and bike incidents.

sources.title: Pet insurance prices across Australia / surgery bills
sources.notes: The page reports average dog/cat quotes by state from 16,652 quote records; these are quote-panel prices, not the insurance market or state uptake.

sources.title: Australian Statistical Geography Standard, Edition 4, State and Territory boundaries
sources.notes: Simplified official state/territory boundaries, excluding Other Territories; the compact GeoJSON splits disconnected exterior rings and attaches enclosed holes for Vega/D3 rendering.

sources.title: National, state and territory population, March 2026
sources.period: Estimated resident population at 31 March 2026; release published 17 September 2026
sources.notes: The 31 March 2026 estimated resident population allocates 520 equal-area hexagons across the eight states and territories using largest-remainder rounding; each hex represents about 53,700 people. The tile map generalizes geography, while the standard state map retains geographic boundaries. Population is not used as a denominator for PetSure insured claims or AMA household estimates.

sources.title: Internal dispute resolution data dashboard and downloadable file
sources.notes: The filtered product is “Personal and domestic property - Domestic pet/horse”. The chart aggregates reported issue counts by half-year from the Product & Issue Relationship sheet and ranks selected issue categories against all issue types in each period. Firm-reported complaint data are deduplicated within categories; one complaint can include up to three issues, so counts across issue categories must not be summed as unique complaints. The original workbook is 48.8 MB and is not included; the chart uses a compact derived CSV.

measure_policy: Do not map AMA state ownership rates: the report does not publish a complete comparable state table.
PetSure state incident counts are shown as insured-claim counts, never as rates or per-pet risk.
Compare the Market state values are averages from its quoted panel, not statewide market prices or take-up.

The 2025 AMA report publishes national pet ownership estimates but no complete comparable state ownership table; use sourced state-level quote sample prices and insured-claim counts for state views, with limitations stated.
